subject: Deployment security patterns and segregation preferences — Dedicated vs Private VPC follow-up
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Jenkins <amelia.jenkins@medicorehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Deployment security patterns and segregation preferences — Dedicated vs Private VPC follow-up

Hi Amelia — thanks again for taking time this morning. Quick recap and a few clarifying questions so we can size the right deployment path (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC). I captured what I heard on the call and where we need confirmation.

Key objectives you mentioned:
- No shared compute for inference of PHI or PII workloads; preference for either Dedicated GPU pools or Private VPC/on-prem.
- Customer-managed encryption keys (bring-your-own-KMS).
- Complete audit trail for inference requests and admin actions; retention target = 7 years.
- Controls on egress and approved outbound destinations (allowlist).
- Ability to demonstrate SOC2 evidence and a vendor security profile for procurement.

Clarifying questions (so we don't over/under-provision):
1) For "no shared compute": do you require physical tenancy (no shared GPUs) or is logical tenancy with strict tenant separation + encryption acceptable for an initial PoC?
2) KMS: is a cloud KMS (AWS KMS customer keys) sufficient, or do you require an on-prem HSM integration?
3) Audit logs: do you need logs delivered to your SIEM (S3/CloudWatch/BigQuery) in addition to Redwood's internal logs?
4) Expected concurrency: peak requests per second (inference calls) and average prompt length (tokens) to help us size Dedicated capacity.

Proposed next steps:
- If you confirm the answers above, we can propose a short two-week PoC on a Dedicated pool (reserved GPUs) scoped to your traffic. If you require Private VPC / on-prem, timeline extends ~4–6 weeks for infra and networking approvals.
- I attached a draft PoC scope spreadsheet so we can mark region, throughput targets, and success criteria.
- We'll schedule a security deep-dive with our security engineer to go over the SOC2 packet and any evidence you need.

Attachments: [Attachment: PoC-scope.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

Thanks — aim to get this scoped this week so the procurement and SRE teams can line up.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199
From: Amelia Jenkins <amelia.jenkins@medicorehealth.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 12:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Deployment security patterns and segregation preferences — Dedicated vs Private VPC follow-up

Hi Soojin — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming items from our side and adding a few specifics so procurement can move quickly: 

Answers to your clarifying questions:
1) Physical tenancy required for production inference of PHI. For PoC, logical tenancy on Dedicated GPUs is acceptable provided we have strong network separation and per-tenant encryption. Production must be Private VPC or Dedicated with dedicated physical capacity (no noisy neighbors).
2) BYOK via AWS KMS customer-managed keys is acceptable. If we move to on-prem later, we'll expect HSM compatibility but not a blocker for PoC.
3) Yes — deliver audit logs to our S3 bucket with lifecycle rules. We also want real-time alerting hooks (Webhook/SNS) for policy violations. Retention policy: 7 years for audit trails and admin actions.
4) Concurrency: expected peak 25 rps, avg prompt ~400 tokens, predict steady-state 8–10 rps.

Procurement ask: please provide your security profile & SOC2 report. I attached our vendor security profile for reference — it lists additional controls (background checks, subcontractor list).

Attachments: [Attachment: MediCore_Security_Profile_v2.pdf (PDF)]

If you can outline the minimal PoC configuration (region + VM/GPU sizes) and an estimated cost range for both a Dedicated PoC and a Private VPC pilot, procurement can review and provide an NDA/PO within 5 business days.

— Amelia
Amelia Jenkins
Head of Platform Security, MediCore
amelia.jenkins@medicorehealth.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Jenkins <amelia.jenkins@medicorehealth.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Deployment security patterns and segregation preferences — Dedicated vs Private VPC follow-up

Amelia / team — appreciate the detail. A few practical notes from the commercial/ops side and a proposed path to minimize lift while meeting your controls: 

Minimal PoC (fastest): Dedicated GPU pool in us-west-2, logically partitioned for MediCore, BYOK via AWS KMS customer keys, audit logs forwarded to your S3 with an initial 90-day retention (we'll set delivery + retention to your bucket); this option can be stood up in ~10 business days. Estimated baseline cost for 2 x A10G nodes for the PoC: $XX,XXX (total for 2 weeks) — I'll put an exact quote in HubSpot tonight.

Private VPC pilot (higher assurance): Private control plane with VPC peering and dedicated compute in your account or dedicated tenancy in our account, full BYOK, SIEM integration, and strict egress controls — timeline ~4–6 weeks primarily due to networking and procurement. There is an onboarding + infra setup fee and an ongoing reserved capacity commitment for production.

Compliance evidence: we'll share our SOC2 Type II and vendor packet in a secure link. For production with physical tenancy guarantees, we'll coordinate an SRE/security questionnaire and can provide architecture diagrams showing no shared GPUs for your tenancy.

Next steps I propose:
- Soojin: update the PoC-scope sheet with the concurrency numbers Amelia provided and pick PoC dates.
- I will add a cost worksheet for both PoC paths and provide an NDA link for MediCore procurement tonight.
- Schedule a 60-minute security deep-dive (Redwood security + your security team) next week to review the SOC2 packet and the audit delivery mechanism.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra

1) Amelia: we'll aim to run the Dedicated PoC first (logical tenancy on dedicated GPUs) for two weeks starting Mon, Apr 4, with immediate transfer to Private VPC for production if procurement confirms physical tenancy requirement. If procurement moves faster we can do Private VPC pilot instead.

2) Action items:
- Soojin: I've updated PoC-scope.xlsx with your concurrency numbers and region (us-west-2). [Attachment: PoC-scope.xlsx]
